diagram_math_checks.justification: These arrows encode spatial exit choices only, not maps or Brownian sample paths. The caption states this explicitly and does not impose absorption. By F4 and the local every-level hitting corollary, both hitting times are finite on a common probability-one event. Continuity gives attainment of a finite first hitting time; distinct levels cannot be occupied at one time. Thus the two strict-order events are disjoint and exhaust that event, exactly as Verification 2.1 states. No deterministic straight-line trajectory is asserted.

The existing three proof steps, facts and hypotheses are unchanged byte-for-byte. The Remarks point back to those steps and supply no premise needed by them. No new supplier, map, commutativity claim or stopping convention is introduced.
